## Reproducibility impact

## Validation

- [ ] `pytest -q` passes
- [ ] New behavior has a regression test
- [ ] CLI output remains readable
- [ ] JSON/SARIF output remains complete when relevant
- [ ] Static demo changes escape user-controlled content
- [ ] No API key, paid service, or hosted backend dependency was added
